body:
## Pull request overview

Adds a new **kernel plugin runtime management protocol** to the spec, expanding the plugin system to cover dynamic loading/unloading, production-safe hot reload, and broader sandboxing/isolation capabilities.

**Changes:**
- Introduces `plugin-runtime.zod.ts` (+ tests) defining dynamic load/unload requests, activation events, discovery configuration, and operation results.
- Enhances `plugin-loading.zod.ts` hot reload (environment + production safety options) and sandboxing (scope + IPC), and updates corresponding tests.
- Updates kernel exports and documentation maps/standards to reference the new/expanded protocols.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-runtime.zod.ts | New schemas for dynamic plugin operations, discovery, and runtime config. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-runtime.test.ts | Vitest coverage for all new runtime schemas and defaults. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-loading.zod.ts | Extends hot reload with production safety controls and sandboxing with scope + IPC. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-loading.test.ts | Updates tests to cover new hot reload/sandboxing fields and new event/state enums. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/index.ts | Exports the new `plugin-runtime` module from the kernel barrel. |
| packages/spec/PROTOCOL_MAP.md | Documents the new runtime protocol and expands plugin-loading description. |
| packages/spec/PLUGIN_STANDARDS.md | Adds a “Plugin Runtime Capabilities” section and an assessment summary table. |
</details>

`PluginDiscoverySourceSchema.endpoint` is used for both URLs and directory paths, but it’s always a plain string. Consider a discriminated union by `type` so `endpoint` can be `z.string().url()` for `registry`/`url` and a path string for `directory`; this matches how other kernel schemas validate URLs.

This assessment table appears to reference lifecycle hooks (`init()`/`start()`/`healthCheck()`/`destroy()`) and service registry details ("17 services across 13 plugins" and `ctx.registerService()`) that aren’t defined in the referenced schemas (`plugin.zod.ts` defines `onInstall`/`onEnable`/etc, and `service-registry.zod.ts` defines registry metadata/config rather than a fixed service count). Please update these rows to reflect the actual schema fields or make them non-numeric/descriptive to avoid going stale.
```suggestion
| Lifecycle Hooks | ✅ | `plugin.zod.ts` — Declarative lifecycle handlers (e.g., `onInstall`, `onEnable`, `onDisable`, `onUninstall`) |
| Service Registry | ✅ | `service-registry.zod.ts` — Service metadata and registration/discovery configuration (schema-defined, not fixed counts) |
```

`DynamicLoadingConfigSchema.allowedSources` is documented as “empty = all allowed”, but the schema is `optional()` with no default, so consumers will see `undefined` (not an empty array) for the “all allowed” case. Either default this to `[]` (and treat empty as “all”), or update the description to state that `undefined` means “all sources allowed”.
```suggestion
   * Allowed plugin sources (undefined or empty array = all sources allowed)
   */
  allowedSources: z.array(z.enum(['npm', 'local', 'url', 'registry', 'git'])).optional()
    .describe('Restrict which source types are permitted (undefined or empty array = all sources allowed)'),
```

`DynamicLoadingConfigSchema.allowedSources` repeats the same source-type enum values already defined in `PluginSourceSchema.type`. Consider extracting a shared `PluginSourceTypeSchema` and reusing it in both places to avoid the lists drifting over time.
